students.name: Student arrivals
students.description: This is practical help for adult students who already have their travel permission and a place to stay. We help plan the journey from the airport, explain the first-week tasks and assist with agreed applications and appointments. You remain in control of your own documents and decisions.
students.need: Student age; university; arrival airport/date; destination postcode; whether accommodation is confirmed; the tasks needing help; and whether the student wants a parent to receive updates.

gifts.name: Gifts & surprises
gifts.description: Tell us the occasion, recipient’s city and total budget. We help choose the gift or suppliers, agree the message and arrange the delivery or event details. A simple delivery does not include someone personally visiting the recipient; request an on-site setup if that is what you need.
gifts.need: Occasion and date; recipient’s city/postcode; approximate gift and service budget; preferences and dietary restrictions; a suitable trusted contact; and whether delivery must remain a surprise.

business.name: Business representation
business.description: You give us a written brief and we attend as your external representative. We can ask your questions, present material you approve, observe what is openly available and send useful notes. You make the commercial decisions and sign your own contracts.
business.need: Your business and website; who we should meet; the purpose; address/date; five key questions; approved presentation; authority limits; and report deadline.

sellers.name: Seller & fulfilment desk
sellers.description: Think of this as a coordination desk between your business, online marketplace and an appropriate warehouse. We help map the work and manage agreed tasks. Your business owns its seller account, stock and customer funds. This is not a ready-made Amazon business or a guaranteed sales service.
sellers.need: Product names/photos, dimensions and weight; quantity; brand ownership; marketplace; business country; forecast monthly orders/returns; and any safety certificates. Do not send stock or identity documents with the first enquiry.

freelancers.name: Freelancer representation
freelancers.description: We can be a clearly identified external representative for your agency or freelance business. You supply the technical knowledge and approved proposal; we help present it, listen and report back. We never pretend to be you or claim your business has a UK office when it does not.
freelancers.need: Your portfolio; service and proposal; client name/location; meeting purpose; approved slides; who answers technical questions; and any confidentiality agreement.

shopping.name: Personal shopping
shopping.description: Send a product link, photo or clear wishlist. We confirm whether it can be bought and shipped lawfully, agree the service fee and ask you to approve the purchase. For a live visit, we show available items over a video call only where the shop permits it. Product costs and international delivery are separate.
shopping.need: Product links/photos; sizes/colours; quantity; maximum goods budget; acceptable alternatives; destination country/city; deadline; and whether you want a live call.

global.name: Global assignments
global.description: Start with the task, not a flight booking. We check whether it can be done remotely, by a suitable local provider or through dedicated travel. Overseas services are individually accepted; there is no permanent Concierge.pk team in every country.
global.need: Country/city; exact task; date flexibility; intended business/person; required access or authorisation; what evidence is needed; and your total travel-and-service budget.

travel.name: Bespoke travel planning
travel.description: We prepare a trip plan based on your budget, dates and needs. You receive a practical route, accommodation options and activity suggestions. At launch you book directly with suppliers or an appropriate travel provider; our planning fee is not the holiday price.
travel.need: Traveller numbers/ages; destinations and dates; approximate trip budget; pace; room needs; interests; and dietary or access preferences. Share sensitive details only through an appropriate private channel if necessary.

pakistan.name: Pakistan gifts & family desk
pakistan.description: Send gifts, plan celebrations or coordinate practical support in Pakistan from overseas.
pakistan.need: Tell us the city, occasion or task, date, budget and recipient contact arrangements.

pakistan-sourcing.name: Pakistan sourcing & supplier visits
pakistan-sourcing.description: Find products, compare suppliers, arrange samples and coordinate pre-shipment checks.
pakistan-sourcing.need: Tell us the product, quantity, specifications, destination country, deadline and required checks.
